This positions Epstein as a conduit offering Saudi royals access to US tech/academic institutions, paralleling the IPI model of using prestigious contacts to build influence networks.

Alsabbagh sent Epstein article about Russian beauty queen selling virginity in Dubai (Sep 23, 2016). Alsabbagh was also introduced to Ruemmler ('obamas former counsel') by Epstein in June 2016 as 'kathy will see you both in new york on the weekend' (EFTA02448066).
